text:
The tool output doesn't show whether Sentinel-2 imagery was used. The 2022 loss comes from the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13), an annual series from 2001 to 2025 with 30 m pixels. The output doesn't name the sensors behind that series, so I can't confirm Sentinel-2. A 30 m pixel size is typical of Landsat-based products, but the output doesn't state this.

What the evidence does show:
- Hansen GFC detected 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022 (3.41% of the 17.6 ha asset).
- JRC GFC2020 maps 100% of the event area as forest in 2020.
- A later year (up to 2025) was observed for this event.
- MGAP 2021 classifies 0.5 ha of the area as native forest, and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest.

If the sensor matters for your analysis, check the Hansen dataset documentation or the run's underlying data lineage.
